tagline: Cleaning chemicals for household, hospitality and industrial use from a South Tangerang manufacturer.

story.title: Cleaning chemicals for household, hospitality and industrial use from a South Tangerang manufacturer.
story.body: Snap Clean is associated publicly with PT Satu Nusa Biru, a soap-and-cleaning-product manufacturer headquartered in Nusa Loka, BSD City. Public marketplace listings show floor cleaner, glass cleaner, detergent and laundry fragrance, while the project repository already contains official Snap Clean product assets scraped from the brand website.
